prompt: Turn this into a clean character turnaround reference sheet for 3D modeling of the character on the left. Draw the same character twice, side by side, at the same size and height, both full body from the top of the head to the feet: on the left a straight front view, on the right a straight side view in profile facing right. In both views it stands upright in a neutral relaxed pose, its arms hanging a little away from its body and its hands open and empty. Replace the curtain and the stage with a plain light gray background, soft even studio light and no cast shadow. Keep the character's design, proportions, colors and matte clay look exactly as they are: the big round orange head with its cream ear pods and short gold collar, the circular gold glasses on the screen, the round orange body with the big cream belly and three round buttons, the short chunky arms and the small round feet. Two changes: remove the antenna and its amber light, so the top of the head is smooth and round; and its face screen behind the glasses is plain matte dark charcoal and blank, with no eyes, no mouth and no glow. No text, no logos, no props, no other characters.
